home.title: Turn technical documents into reliable automotive knowledge.
home.description: Meccanico IA is building a source-agnostic pipeline that preserves evidence, structures diagnostic reasoning, and prepares knowledge for a future mechanic-facing assistant.
home.scopeDescription: This first milestone establishes the application shell, strict tooling, environment validation, and bilingual text infrastructure. PDF upload comes next.
home.pipelineTitle: A knowledge pipeline designed to grow
home.pipelineDescription: PDF is the first source. The domain stays independent so future inputs can produce the same structured automotive cases.

ingest.title: Ingest
ingest.description: Preserve the original source and its technical context.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: Separate facts, inferences, checks, repairs, and outcomes.

retrieve.title: Retrieve
retrieve.description: Prepare traceable knowledge for mechanics and future conversations.

evidence.title: Evidence first
evidence.description: Important information remains connected to its original source.

uncertainty.title: Uncertainty preserved
uncertainty.description: Possible causes never become confirmed repairs without support.

sources.title: Source agnostic
